readout_other: Trigeminal blink reflex R2 recovery cycle (conditioned/unconditioned R2 area, ISI 250 and 500 ms) at T0, 3 and 30 min after TUS
direction_notes: Superior colliculus TUS increased the conditioned R2 area at 3 min (T1) but not at 30 min, indicating increased brainstem excitability; nucleus raphe magnus, substantia nigra and sham TUS produced no change.
safety_notes: The experimental procedures were well tolerated by all subjects and none reported adverse effects or any skin sensation during or after TUS.

timing.protocol_description: Standard diagnostic transcranial imaging settings (B-mode with simultaneous pulsed-wave Doppler, 2 MHz, PRF 4340) with the mechanical index at 100% (1.4; TIC 2.2) and the probe frequency reduced to 1.75 MHz; the target nucleus was kept on screen and insonated for 180 s. Sham used the 'freezing' machine ultrasound option.

flags.reason: Diagnostic probe frequency lowered to 1.75 MHz for B-mode; the pulsed-wave Doppler ran at 2 MHz simultaneously. Recorded 1750 kHz.
PRF 4340 is the pulsed-wave Doppler PRF as written (no unit given; presumably Hz). Pulse duration and duty cycle are not stated; the imaging B-mode pulse timing is not described.
Single simulated (k-Wave) pressure of 152 kPa 'in the brainstem' applied to all three targets; the paper does not give per-nucleus values and gives no intensity.
Four sessions per subject include one sham session (three TUS sessions).
Targets were identified on transcranial B-mode imaging; ~15 mm target area, substantial overlap between nuclei likely. Nucleus raphe magnus mapped to raphe_nuclei.
Sham used the 'freezing' option of the ultrasound machine; classed as inactive_transducer.
Spelled out as 'Sixteen' in the text.
